name: Straits ERP — document palette (light only)
purpose: Payslips, EA forms, statements, invoices, POs, remittance advice. Light mode only: documents are printed or read on white.
colour_space: sRGB. Convert to CMYK with your press ICC profile — do NOT use a naive RGB→CMYK formula, the teal and amber shift badly.
rules: A negative figure is not bad news. Deductions, contra entries and credit notes take NEUTRAL ink, never red. Reserve amounts.unfavorable for a stated business judgement.
Colour is never the only encoding. Status marks carry a glyph; chart series carry a dash or pattern.
Statutory forms are frequently printed mono. Every colour below has a grayscale equivalent that preserves its relative weight.

fills._note: Screen tints are too light for paper. These are darkened to stay visible through a 600dpi laser. Screen equivalents are listed under screen_reference.

grand_total_row.guidance: No fill. Use a 1pt rule above and a 3pt double rule below, with bold weight. A filled grand total reads as a highlight, not a conclusion.

status._note: Glyph is mandatory. It is what survives mono printing and red/green colour deficiency.

amounts._note: PAYROLL: earnings and deductions both use `neutral`. A deduction is arithmetic, not a warning.

chart._note: Five categorical series, no valence. Verified min ΔE 0.109 normal vision, 0.094 under deuteranopia. Beyond five, aggregate into Other. Pair each with a dash or fill pattern.

screen_reference._note: The original screen tints, for parity between the app and its documents.
